claims: The opening night of "The Romantic Tour" was in Las Vegas on April 10, 2026.
Bruno Mars has a 2026 album titled "The Romantic".
The show on the opening night of "The Romantic Tour" concludes with an encore of "Dance With Me".

"The Romantic Tour" 2026 setlist (approx. April 10, Las Vegas) is: Risk It All, Cha Cha Cha, On My Soul, 24K Magic, Treasure, God Was Showing Off, I Just Might, Perm (with elements of Finesse), Why You Wanna Fight, Low Rider Medley (Oh Girl, Miss You, Everything, Wannabe, That's What I Like), Something Serious, Blast Off (Silk Sonic), 777 (Silk Sonic), Fly As Me (Silk Sonic), Smoking Out The Window (Silk Sonic), Leave The Door Open (Silk Sonic), Marry You, Die With A Smile, Piano Medley (It Will Rain, Talking to the Moon, When I Was Your Man, Versace on the Floor), Locked Out of Heaven, Just the Way You Are, Uptown Funk, Encore: Dance With Me.
